title: Prepare the identity diagnostic scratch parent in fresh checkouts
head: fix/ui861-identity-fresh-scratch-20261009
body:
## Summary

A fresh checkout has no `.tmp` parent, so the diagnostic regression failed with ENOENT before its assertions. Create the task-owned scratch parent recursively with the existing `mkdirSync` import immediately before the existing `mkdtempSync` call.

This repair is one insertion in `tests/conformance-playwright-identity.test.mjs` relative to frozen parent `a58cae49d4cbbed48e62c877bab24a7c0041bef6`. The test body, all18 controls, identity checks, failure diagnostics and cleanup remain unchanged. New source SHA: `b7f143099ab8bbb6be69f49f6dbfd6c97831d902` on `fix/ui861-identity-fresh-scratch-20261009`.

## Linked Issue

Refs #825, #861 and #865. Runtime and full-browser acceptance remains OPEN. This increment does not close or replace existing drafts.

Exact finite checks on `b7f143099ab8bbb6be69f49f6dbfd6c97831d902`:

- PASS: unchanged original entry `node --test tests/conformance-playwright-identity.test.mjs`,18 tests,18 pass,0 fail,0 skips. Ran in a newly created checkout of this branch; `.tmp` was absent immediately before the entry, with no external precreation. The test itself created the parent, and existing cleanup removed its diagnostic scratch child.
- PASS: `pnpm exec eslint --no-ignore --config vue/eslint.config.mjs tests/conformance-playwright-identity.test.mjs`.
- PASS: `git diff --check a58cae49d4cbbed48e62c877bab24a7c0041bef6 HEAD`. Exact comparison confirms the file is the old file plus only the requested `mkdirSync` line.
- PASS: fresh-default `git merge-tree --write-tree 8db0ac8f49749e3e5f28be5051bb3d3ed71ada71 b7f143099ab8bbb6be69f49f6dbfd6c97831d902`, exit0, tree `eb435a2b28dc901b99236bbfac324e09eeabc7b9`.

Original a58 unprepared17/18 FAIL and externally prepared18/18 PASS remain preserved at prior evidence commit `374086720f5812f89f71489fa678201449c77486`. They have not been relabeled or overwritten.

All browser cells, browser aggregate, full repository gates, visual/native/platform and consumer acceptance are UNRUN on this new source. Previous a58 Chromium PASS and aggregate FAIL are historical evidence only. No browser traces were recreated or rebound. The install-deps authentication refusal remains stopped; no credential, permission, security or system-directory change was made.

Root alone handles GitHub content and PR actions. The same existing reviewer `01a11be6-6368-757d-86b1-6bf51fafa038` can verify this ordinary fresh-checkout correction separately from full-browser acceptance. No merge or package publication occurred. The one commit can be reviewed independently or cherry-picked onto the approved integration; frozen a58 and6583 source branches remain intact.
